violation_type.title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: The center director has been unable to meet director responsibility requirements. Repeated deficiencies in the areas of background checks and fire safety have occurred.

finding_variants.text: The center director has been unable to meet director responsibility requirements. Repeated deficiencies in the areas of background checks and fire safety have occurred.
The operation's director has not ensured required inspections for the operation from third-party entities are being completed timely.

The toddler and infant classroom were over ratio. Ratio has been an ongoing issue and the director has been made aware by staff on more than one occasion.
RE-CITE: Director is not ensuring the operation is operating in compliance with the minimum standards.
The director has not ensured that the daycare is operating in compliance with minimum standards.
